sections.Profile:
The "Rodeo" pinball machine, produced by Midway Manufacturing Co. in October 1964, is a two-player electro-mechanical game featuring a Western rodeo theme. A distinctive feature of this machine is its turret-style ball shooter, operated by a large knob on the lockdown bar, allowing players to aim the ball at specific targets, enhancing gameplay precision.

- Manufacturer: Midway Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1964
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Western, Rodeo, Horses, Original Theme
